m: 1. उद्-√ धा (उद्-√ धा) P. (Subj. 2. pl. -दधातन) to erect (कपृथम्), RV. x, 101, 12; to expose (an infant), ŚBr. iv, 5, 2, 13.

√ 2. उद्-धा (उद्- √ 1. हा) Ā. -जिहीते (p. उज्-जिहान, RV. v, 5, 1 = AV. xiii, 2, 46; see also below) to go upwards, move upwards, rise up, RV.; AV. viii, 7, 21; VS.; TBr.; BhP. &c.; to open (as a door), RV. ix, 5, 5; to go out or away, start from, leave, RV. v, 5, 1; Daś.; Naiṣ. &c.
a: उद्धा — I. {c3c} P. Ved. 1 To abandon or expose (an infant). --2 To set up, erect, build. II. {c3c} A. 1 To go or move upwards, rise (as the sun, dust &c.); यतो रजः पार्थिवमुज्जिहीते R. 13. 64; Mu. 4. 21; Bk. 18. 27; N. 22. 45, 55. --2 To go away from, depart; उज्जिहानजीवितां Māl. 10. --3 To raise; शिरसा यूपमुज्जिहीते Kāty. --4 To throw up, knit (as eyebrows); Bk. 3. 47.
उद्धांत — a. Ejected, vomited. --तः An elephant out of rut (from whose temples ichor ceases to flow).

corpulent, inflated, L.
उद्धान n. the act of ejecting, vomiting, L.
a fireplace, L.
a: उद्धान — a. 1 Ejected, vomited. --2 Inflated, corpulent, fat. --3 Gone up, ascended, risen. --नं 1 A fireplace. --2 Ejecting, vomiting.

उद्-धारा (आ), f. the plant Cocculus Cordifolius, L.

klI, (ut + Df + GaY .) udDAnam । ityamarawIkAyAM svAmI ॥ unan AkA ityAdi BAzA ।

m: उद्-धार &c. See 2. उद्-धृ.
उद्-धार अस्, m. (in some senses perhaps from 1. उद्-√ धृ), the act of raising, elevating, lifting up
drawing out, pulling out, Gaut.; MBh. Comm. on BṛĀrUp.
removing, extinction, payment (of a debt)
taking away, deduction
omission, Mn. Comm. on Yājñ.
selection, a part to be set aside, selected part
exception, TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; Mn. &c.
selecting (a passage), selection, extract (of a book) Comm. on Kir. x, 10
extraction, deliverance, redemption, extrication, MBh.; Prab. &c.
a portion, share
a surplus (given by the Hindū law to the eldest son beyond the shares of the younger ones), W.
the first part of a patrimony, W.
the sixth part of booty taken in war (which belongs to the prince), W.
a debt (esp. one not bearing interest), KātyDh.
obligation, Daś.
recovering property
refutation, Car. Comm. on Nyāyad.
उद्-धार (अम्), n. a fireplace, L.
a: उद्धारः — 1 Drawing out, extraction. --2 Deliverance, redemption, saving, rescuing, extrication. --3 Raising, lifting up. --4 Deduction, a part to be set aside. --5 (In law) A part to be set aside from the paternal property for the benefit of the eldest son; the surplus allowed by Law to the eldest beyond the shares of the younger brothers; Ms. 9. 112. --6 The sixth part of booty taken in war which belongs to the king; Ms. 7. 97. --7 An obligation. --8 Debt, particularly such as bears no interest. --9 Recovering property. --10 Marching out. --11 Citing (a passage), quoting. --12 Final beatitude. --13 Prosperity, elevation. --रा The plant गुडूची. --रं A fireplace.

k.v: उद्धारोऽर्थप्रयोगस्तु कुसीदं वृद्धिजीविका। याच्ञयाप्तं याचितकं निमयादापमित्यकम्.।

m: उद्-धारण n. the act of raising, elevating
drawing out, BhP.
the act of giving out or paying, Pañcat. 138, 14 (ed. Kosegarten).
a: उद्धारणं — 1 Raising, elevating. --2 Rescuing, drawing out of (danger), delivering. --3 Sharing, dividing.

m: उद्धारक mfn. one who raises or lifts, drawing out, L.
paying, giving out, affording.
उद्धारक—विधि m. mode of giving out or paying, Pañcat. ii, 38, 18 (ed. Bühler).
उद्-धार—कोश m. N. of wk.
उद्-धार—विभाग m. division of shares, partition.
उद्-धारित mfn. taken out, drawn forth, extricated
released.

to be cured, Car.
to be delivered.

k.v: प्रत्युत्क्रमः प्रयोगार्थः प्रक्रमः स्यादुपक्रमः। स्यादभ्यादानमुद्धात आरम्भः सम्भ्रमस्त्वरा॥

m: उद्-√ धी P. (impf. 3. pl. -अदीधयुस्) to look upwards with desire, RV. vii, 33, 5.

उद्-√ धू P. Ā. -धूनोति and -धुनोति, -नुते, to rouse up, shake up, move, cause to rise (dust), RV. x, 23, 4; MBh.; R.; Ragh.; VarBṛS. &c.; to throw upwards, lift up, MBh.; Kathās. &c.; to kindle; to disturb, excite, MBh. &c.; to shake off, throw off; to expel.
a: उद्धू — {c5c} {c9c} U. 1 To shake, move up, raise, throw up, wave (as a chawari); कैर्नोद्धूतानि चामराणि K. 117, 200; Ku. 2. 29; उद्धुनीयात सत्केतून् Bk. 19 8; Ki. 5. 39. --2 To shake or throw off; Śi. 18. 8, dispel, destroy (fig.), उद्धूतपापाः Me. 55. --3 To disturb, excite, rouse up.

v: na॰ DUlivadunmardayati ud + DUli--Ric । udDUlayati tataH BAve lyuw । 1 DUlivanmarddane 2 pAkArTopakaraRaBede ca । (maSAlAcUrRRa) “cUrRasyodDUlanaM deyaM Bojye kzIrekzusamBave । vyaYjanezu ca sarvvezu SAkajezvannajezu ca । mAMsamatsyaBavezvevaM pralehatalanAdizu । AdAveva pacet snehe tatohiNgUdakaM kzipet । vesavAraM salavaRaM kziptvA tat piSitaM pacet । ardDasvinne kzipettakramaTa vA dAqimIrasam । sidDe pAke ca dAtavyaM cUrRamudDUlanasya tat” pAkaSAstram ।
m: उद्-धूलन n. the act of sprinkling with dust or powder, Bālar. 185, 19.
a: उद्धूलनं — 1 Powdering, sprinkling with dust or powder; भस्मोद्धूलन K. P. 10; K. 129. --2 An article used to season food.

m: उद्-धूलय Nom. (fr. धूलि with उद्) P. -धूलयति, to powder, sprinkle with dust or powder, Kathās.; Kād.

a: उद्धूलयति — Den. P. To powder, sprinkle with powder or dust.

m: उद्धूमायित mfn. filled with vapour, Mālatīm.

s: klI, (ut + DUY + Ric + lyuw .) ekatritElAlavaNgakarpUrakastUromaricatvacacUrRam । iti pAkarAjeSvaraH ॥

a kind of powder, L.
a: उद्धूननं — 1 Throwing upwards, raising. --2 Shaking.

m: उद्-धूपन n. (fr. Nom. धूपय with उद्) fumigation, Suśr.
a: उद्धूपनं — Fumigating.

m: उद्-धूत mfn. (sometimes उद्-धुत) shaken up, raised, caused to rise, MBh.; Ragh.; Kum. &c.
thrown upwards, tossed up, scattered above, MBh.; R.; Prab.
kindled (as fire), Ragh. vii, 45; Kathās.
excited, agitated, Hariv.; R.; Kathās.
shaken off, fallen from or off, thrown off or away, Hariv.; BhP.
exalted
high, loud, MBh.; Hariv.
उद्-धूत n. (उद्धूत) stamping, Hariv.
turning up, digging, Hariv.
roaring (of the ocean), MBh.
a: उद्धूत — p. p. 1 Shaken off, fallen from; raised or thrown up; मारुतभरोद्धूतोपि धूलिव्रजः Dhan. V. --2 Exalted, high, loud.

m: उद्-धूत—पाप mfn. one who has shaken off his sins, Megh. 56.
उद्धूति f. shaking, brandishing, Mālatīm.

a: उद्धूषणं — Erection of the hair (on the body), thrill, horripilation.

m: उद्-धूषित mfn. having the hairs erect (through joy), Pañcat.

उद्-धम m. breathing hard, panting
blowing, sounding, L.

उद्धम — a. [उद्-ध्मा-श] Sounding, blowing. --मः 1 Sounding, blowing. --2 Breathing hard, panting.

उद्-धन् (उद्-√ हन्) P. -धन्ति (Ved. impf. 3. sg. -अहन्, RV. x, 102, 7; Impv. -हन्तु, iii, 33, 13, 2. du. -हतम्, i, 184, 2, &c.) Ā. (3. pl. उज्-जिघ्नन्ते, RV. i, 64, 11; Ved. inf. -धन्तवै, ŚBr. xiii, 8, 1, 20) to move or push or press upwards or out, lift up, throw away, RV.; ŚBr.; to root up or out, BhP.; to turn up (the earth), dig, throw open, TS.; ŚBr.; TBr. &c.: (Ā.) to kill one's self, hang one's self, R.; Pañcat.
a: उद्धन् — {c2c} P. [उद्-हन्] To raise up, elevate (fig. also); see उद्धत.

m: उद्-धन m. (√ हन्) a wooden swordlike instrument for stirring boiled rice, L.
उद्-धनन n. the act of throwing up or turning up Comm. on Nyāyam.

v: strI udDara avasfja ityucyate yasyAM kriyAyAm mayU॰ sa॰ । udDaraRAvasarjanArTanideSakriyAyAm ।
m: उद्धरावसृजा f. any act in which it is said उद्धर! अवसृज!, [or उत्सृज!] g. मयूरव्यंसकादि, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 72.
उद्-धर &c. See 2. उद्-धृ.
1. उद्-धर m. N. of a Rakṣas, L.
उद्-धर mfn. v.l. for उद्-धुर, q.v., MBh. iii, 11188.
2. उद्-धर (2. sg. Impv. forming irregular Tatpuruṣa compounds).
a: उद्धर, उद्धार — See under उद्धृ.

to be extracted, W.
to be separated Comm. on Nyāyam.

m: उद्-धरण n. (in some meanings perhaps from 1. उद्-√ धृ, q.v.), the act of taking up, raising, lifting up, MBh.; Śārṅg.
the act of drawing out, taking out, tearing out, Mn.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
means of drawing out, Vet.
taking off (clothes), Suśr.
taking away, removing, Vām.
putting or placing before, presenting, treatment, KātyŚr. iv, 1, 10
extricating, delivering, rescuing, Hit.; Ragh. &c.
taking away (a brand from the Gārhapatya-fire to supply other sacred fires), KātyŚr.
eradication
extermination
the act of destroying
vomiting, bringing up
vomited food
final emancipation, L.
उद्-धरण m. N. of the father of king Śantanu (the author of a commentary on a portion of the Mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇa).
a: उद्धरणं — 1 Drawing or taking out, taking off (clothes &c.). --2 Extraction, pulling or tearing out; कंटक˚ Ms. 9. 252; चक्षुषोरुद्धरणं Mit.; so शल्य˚ --3 Extricating, deliverance, rescuing (from danger); दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य R. 2. 25; स बंधुर्यो विपन्नानामापदुद्धरणक्षमः H. 1. 3. --4 Destruction, eradication, extermination, deposition, dethronement; चंद्रगुप्तस्योद्धरणात् Mu. 4. --5 Lifting, raising. --6 Taking a part or share. --7 Taking from the Gārhapatya fire to supply the other sacred fires. --8 Vomiting. --9 Anything vomited. --10 Final emancipation. --11 Acquittance of debt.

m: उद्-धर्म m. unsound doctrine, heresy.
उद्धरोत्सृजा f. any act in which it is said उद्धर! अवसृज!, [or उत्सृज!] g. मयूरव्यंसकादि, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 72.
उद्-धर्तव्य mfn. to be drawn out, Kathās.
to be separated Comm. on Nyāyam.
उद्-धर्तृ mfn. one who raises or lifts up
a sharer, co-heir
one who recovers property, W.
उद्-धर्तृ m. a destroyer, exterminator, Yājñ.

a: उद्धवः — 1 A sacrificial fire. --2 A festival, holiday. --3 N. of a Yādava, uncle and friend of Kṛṣṇa. When Kṛṣṇa was taken by Akrūra to Mathurā Uddhava was implored by the citizens of Gokula to go and fetch him. He was very much attached to Kṛṣṇa. On seeing the destruction of the Yādavas to be inevitable, he went to Kṛṣṇa and asked him what to do; whereupon he was told to go to Badarikāśrama to practise penance and to secure heaven. He is the subject of two short poems, उद्धवदूत and उद्धवसंदेश.

k.v: शङ्खो लक्ष्मीपतेः पाञ्चजन्यश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम्. कौमोदकी गदा खड्गो नन्दकः कौस्तुभो मणिः। चापः शार्ङ्गंमुरारेस्तु श्रीवत्सो लाञ्छनं स्मृतम्. अश्वाश्च शैव्यसुग्रीवमेघपुष्पबलाहकाः। सारथिर्दारुको मन्त्री ह्युद्धवश्चानुजो गदः॥

Ā. -धरति, -ते (p. -धरत्, RV.; pf. 3. pl. उज्-जहरुस्, AV. iii, 9, 6; aor. -अहार्षम्, AV.) to take out, draw out, bring or tear out, pull out, eradicate; to extricate, RV. x, 68, 4; AV. viii, 2, 15; xx, 136, 16; ĀśvGṛ.; KātyŚr.; MBh.; Śak. &c.; to draw, ladle up, skim, AV.; ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; R.; to take away (fire, or anything from the fire), TS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.; to raise, lift up, TS.; ĀśvGṛ.; MBh.; Mn. &c.; to rescue (from danger &c.), deliver, free, save, AV. viii, 2, 28; MaitrUp.; MBh.; Vikr. &c.; to put away or off, remove; to separate, MBh.; BhP.; Suśr. &c.; to leave out, omit; to except (see उद्-धृत्य); to select, choose: Ā. to take for one's self, AV. iii, 9, 6; TS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.; to extend, elevate, raise; to make strong or brisk or quick, MBh.; Suśr.; MārkP. &c.; to present, offer, Yājñ. i, 159; BhP. iv, 30, 47; to root out, destroy, undo, MBh.; Ragh.; Prab. &c.; to divide (in math.) : Caus. -धारयति, to raise, up-lift, MBh.; to take for one's self, MBh. xiv, 1928 : Desid. उज्-जिहीर्षति, to wish to draw out or to rescue, Mn. iv, 251; MBh.

m: उद्-धुर mfn. (fr. धुर् with उद्; cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 74), freed from a yoke or burden, unrestrained, wild, lively, cheerful, Śiś. v, 64; Ragh.; Kathās. &c.
heavy, thick, gross, firm, Śiś.; Daś. &c.
high, L.
a: उद्धुर — a. [उद्गता धूरस्मात्] 1 Freed from a burden or yoke, unrestrained, unchecked, free. --2 Firm, intrepid, bold; अभियोग˚ Mv. 6. --3 Victorious, conquering. --4 High, loud (voice &c); पितरमुद्धुरध्वनिमहाजनानुयातमानीय Dk. 104. --5 Heavy, full of; Śi. 5. 64. --6 Thick, gross. --7 Lively, cheerful. --8 Able, competent; Bv. 4. 40.

m: उद्-धुषण n. (corrupted from उद्-धर्षण?) erection of the hair, L.
उद्-√ ध्वंस् Ā. -ध्वंसते, to be affected or attacked (by disease &c.), Car. : Caus. P. -ध्वंसयति, to attack, cause to befall, affect, MBh.; Car.
उद्-ध्वंस m. destruction, Car. ii, 2, 8
affection (of the throat), hoarseness, Suśr.; Car.
the state of being attacked (by infectious disorders &c.), an epidemic, Car. iii, 3.
a: उद्ध्वंसः — Hoarseness (of sound).

m: उद्-ध्वंसन n. affection (of the throat), Car.
an epidemic, Car. iii, 3.
उद्-ध्वे (उद्-√ ह्वे) P. -ध्वयति (impf. 1. sg. -अह्वम्, AV.) to call out, entice, AV. x, 10, 22; xviii, 2, 23; AitBr.
